`native-same-host.stdout` is an unchanged excerpt of the real default Ansible
callback from the disposable Issue #226 decommission resume on 2026-11-03,
candidate `b862fd1b77aa195e2c25a179cf89243d7b43f133`. It contains the generic
absent-roster inspection and the old retirement response for the same synthetic
FQDN. The full private transcript remains in the acceptance artifact bundle.

The regression emits this captured collision alongside the current production
helper/debug tasks through real Ansible, then invokes the production parser,
central-step Inspect, and independent Verify. Typed payloads describe Pilot's
own protocol; they are not invented FreeIPA CLI output.
